footer.tagline: Reference implementation for Altinn access control

hero.title: Access control with Altinn in your own portal
hero.description: A practical reference implementation for public service owners who want to use Altinn's authorisation platform to manage access in their own portal and platform solutions. Explore the end-user API, service owner API and PDP with live examples.

features.heading: What does DigitalPortal demonstrate?
features.subheading: Three main sections cover the most important integration points with Altinn authorisation.

sluttbruker.title: End-User API
sluttbruker.description: Demonstrates access control from the end user's perspective. See how a user can log in, retrieve their rights, and access services on behalf of themselves or an organisation.

tjenesteeiger.title: Service Owner API
tjenesteeiger.description: Shows how you as a service owner can manage access to your services. Create and manage resources, delegate rights, and control who has access to what.

pdp.title: Policy Decision Point (PDP)
pdp.description: Integrate Altinn's PDP directly into your application to make authorisation decisions in real time. See examples of XACML-based requests and responses for access control.

highlights.heading: Why use Altinn for access control?
highlights.subheading: Altinn has built access control infrastructure that you can reuse in your own solution.

realtime.title: Real-time access control
realtime.text: Make authorisation decisions directly in your portal via Altinn PDP without extra round trips.

standards.title: Standards-based security
standards.text: XACML, Maskinporten and ID-porten – build on established, secure standards.

public.title: For public service owners
public.text: Designed for organisations that want to use Altinn as an authoritative source for access.

ready.title: Ready to use
ready.text: Reference code you can use directly as a starting point for your own implementation.

cta.heading: Get started
cta.subheading: Choose one of the demo sections and see code and API calls in practice.

sluttbrukerApi.heading: Access control via the end-user API
sluttbrukerApi.description: This section demonstrates how an end user can authenticate via ID-porten and retrieve their rights and access through Altinn's end-user API.
sluttbrukerApi.wip: Under development – demo content coming here.

tjenesteeigerApi.heading: Access management via the service owner API
tjenesteeigerApi.description: This shows how you as a service owner use Maskinporten and Altinn's service owner API to create resources, manage rights and control access in your services.
tjenesteeigerApi.wip: Under development – demo content coming here.

pdp.heading: Policy Decision Point (PDP)
pdp.description: Demonstrates integration with Altinn's PDP to make authorisation decisions in real time. See XACML requests and responses, and understand how you can use PDP directly in your application logic.
pdp.wip: Under development – demo content coming here.
